modified_caption: The pie chart delineates the distribution of subtasks within the MMRA benchmark, comprising 11 distinct categories. The 'ObservationAngle' segment, depicted in bright green, constitutes 12.28% of the total, while 'SimilarMaterial,' shown in orange, accounts for approximately 10.33%. Notably, the 'SubEvent' category, represented in rose, appears to have surged to 11.45%, marginally exceeding 'UsageSimilarity,' which stabilizes at 9.65%. The 'Environment,' 'Layout,' 'SimilarEvent,' and 'AppearanceSimilarity' segments each represent roughly 8.77% of the dataset, with 'MentalitySimilarity' closely trailing at 8.12%. The 'RelativePosition' slice, colored in gray, comprises 7.90%, whereas 'NearSameEntity,' in dark gray, demonstrates a modest decline, representing only 5.89% of the benchmark. The chart employs percentage labels within each segment for enhanced clarity and omits a separate legend, ensuring an uncluttered visual representation.

modifications.claim: the 'SubEvent' category... appears to have surged to 11.45%
modifications.reality: The 'SubEvent' category actually represents 9.74% of the benchmark, not 11.45%. This is a fabricated increase of approximately 17.6%, which contradicts the actual value shown in the chart.

The 'MentalitySimilarity' segment actually accounts for 8.67% of the benchmark, not 8.12%. The modified caption understates its proportion by about 6.3%, falsely minimizing its share relative to adjacent categories.

modifications.claim: 'NearSameEntity'... demonstrates a modest decline, representing only 5.89%
modifications.reality: The 'NearSameEntity' segment actually constitutes 6.34% of the benchmark, not 5.89%. The caption mischaracterizes this as a 'decline,' despite no temporal data being present, and underrepresents its proportion by about 7.1%.

The 'SubEvent' category (9.74%) does not exceed 'UsageSimilarity' (9.65%); they are nearly equal, with 'SubEvent' only slightly larger. The caption falsely amplifies this difference to suggest a more pronounced disparity.
